transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got four routine support visits scheduled for tomorrow — a vehicle-inspection team, a water-system contractor, a network-maintenance team, and a refrigerated repair-parts delivery. We need to assign each one to a gate and a receiving window. Gates 1 through 4 are available, and our standard windows are 0600, 0800, 1000, and 1300. Before we finalize anything, I need to hear from each of you if there are any constraints or issues I should know about — security concerns, scheduling conflicts, facility requirements, anything. Once we've got the plan sorted, I'll sign it and we'll get it posted to the guard desk and the receiving yard. Who wants to start?
